pages.about:
GO World News is an international digital news service. Our mission is to report the news that matters across borders — quickly, accurately and fairly.

[Starter text — replace with the publisher's approved About text in Dashboard → Settings.]
pages.editorialStandards:
Accuracy: we verify information before publishing and attribute claims to their sources.

Corrections: when we get something wrong we correct it promptly and say so at the end of the article. All corrections are listed on our Corrections page.

Independence: advertising and sponsored content are clearly labelled and never influence editorial decisions.

Fairness: we seek responses from people and organisations we report on.

[Starter text — review and approve in Dashboard → Settings.]

We collect the minimum data needed to run GO World News. Website analytics are first-party and do not store IP addresses. Newsletter emails are used only to send the newsletters you chose, and every email includes a one-click unsubscribe link. The mobile app registers an anonymous device identifier; push notifications are sent only if you opt in. You can delete your reader account at any time from the Account page.

children.text: Demonstration content: this story was written to preview the GO World News platform. It does not describe a real event, and any people quoted are fictional.
The carrier said the first flights would operate three times a week, with schedules timed so that same-day business trips become possible for the first time.
Travel agents in the demo scenario described strong early interest from small exporters who move samples and documents between the cities.
For many families this turns a two-day trip into a morning flight.
What happens next
Airport operators said baggage and customs teams would be added for the new services, and that passenger feedback would shape the timetable after the first season.

children.text: Demonstration content: this story was written to preview the GO World News platform. It does not describe a real event, and any people quoted are fictional.
Port managers in this demonstration story said vessels currently wait an average of several days before a berth becomes free.
The upgrade adds two ship-to-shore cranes and an online slot-booking system for trucks, which the operator says will reduce congestion at the gates.
Key points
What happens next
Dock worker representatives said they had been consulted on training for the new equipment and would monitor how shifts change.

corrections.note: An earlier version of this demo story gave the wrong number of new cranes. The upgrade adds two cranes, not three.

children.text: Demonstration content: this story was written to preview the GO World News platform. It does not describe a real event, and any people quoted are fictional.
Researchers at the fictional station grow tomatoes and leafy greens in greenhouses cooled by evaporating sea water.
Soil and leaf sensors decide when plants are watered, which the team says has cut water use sharply in early trials.
Every litre we save matters when rain is this rare.

The scientists caution that energy costs and maintenance still need to fall before farmers could adopt the system widely.

children.text: Demonstration content: this story was written to preview the GO World News platform. It does not describe a real event, and any people quoted are fictional.
Verification starts by asking where an image first appeared online and whether an older copy exists.
Editors then compare landmarks, weather and shadows with the claimed time and place.
Key points

items.text: Search for earlier copies of the image
Compare shadows with the claimed time
Record every step in the verification log

children.text: What happens next

7hegtcnf18.headline: Why local reporting matters more in a connected world

children.text: Demonstration content: this story was written to preview the GO World News platform. It does not describe a real event, and any people quoted are fictional.
